name: @loomidev/icons
description: Shared icon registry for loomi components: an inlined Heroicons set plus disk-based Iconsax and Untitled UI icon sets, with a runtime register API.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-disk-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-disk-modules.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-svg-assets.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/build-disk-manifest.mjs && node scripts/build-disk-modules.mjs && node scripts/copy-svg-assets.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch
